FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 329
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/02/2026
House Bill 329 as introduced would codify an existing rule of the State Department of
Education to require public school students, beginning with students who will graduate during
the 2031-2032 school year, to earn at least one credit in a department approved computer
science course. This bill could increase the administrative obligations of the department to
ensure that computer science courses meet certain instructional criteria.

FN-BYZAEQJ-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 329
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/05/2026
House Bill 329 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy would codify an existing
rule of the State Department of Education to require public school students, beginning with
students who will graduate during the 2031-2032 school year, to earn at least one credit in a
department approved computer science course, or a department approved course with embedded
computer science skills and experiences. This bill could increase the administrative obligations
of the department to ensure that computer science courses meet certain instructional criteria.
